lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs are distributed in multiple vertical columns and horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity align with the columns of circular blobs, creating intersecting nodes of high luminance.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges traverse the upper third of the flank, characterized by a light-to-shadow gradient across the vertical axis.
